YingBay OpenWrt apk plugins 1.1.0-r1

Install on OpenWrt 25+ / snapshot (apk):

  apk add --allow-untrusted ./yingbay_1.1.0-r1_all.apk
  apk add --allow-untrusted ./luci-app-yingbay_1.1.0-r1_all.apk

Then open LuCI: 服务 -> 映湾影视
Phone UI: http://router-ip:3000/

Need node runtime: apk add node

SHA256:
  yingbay: caa0e1e5d62ade6cd8c657af4488b4c227a4989cab8c2a04a33c3e5022af0d10
  luci-app-yingbay: d6b983458dd9ac81351b60d8872001b65b78d1b063e9d49e8f6c55ef9a84ade3
